most_similar_reason: Candidate 5 is essentially the same epic: exile engineered by a stepmother wanting her own son crowned, the loyal wife won by a bow-feat and the devoted younger brother in exile, the demoness whose nose and ears are cut off, the golden-deer ruse and the abduction by the many-headed island demon king, the alliance with the monkey people against a usurper, the search by a devoted monkey ally, and the final defeat of the demon king.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 2 is not a narrative at all but a terminological and theological discussion of a word for sacred power, sharing no characters, episodes, or plot with the target.
